brief: Coffee futures closed at 306¢/lb — up 5.7% on the week and up 3.3% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 21 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (+0.8σ). The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is watch. The Brazilian real is little changed on the month (-1.6%) — a neutral currency backdrop. Looking ahead: the 14-day forecast calls for 27 mm of rain in the robusta belt against a 90 mm seasonal norm (-0.9σ) — projected crop stress: low (Open-Meteo forecast model, issued 2026-10-16; skill scored publicly as windows close).
